text: In 1955, French authorities brought obscenity charges against the publisher and anonymous author of Story Of O. The courts rejected the charges against the publisher, but a publicity ban was imposed for a number of years. Later, on 15 September 1994, the Ministry of Home Affairs in Malaysia banned the book under the Printing Presses and Publications Act.
meta_description: Story Of O: obscenity charges in France in 1955, rejected by the courts but followed by a publicity ban; banned in Malaysia in 1994.
